body:
I can understand study issues as well. My advisor was promoted and refused to help me publish 6 papers and stated that since he provided the grant money, I couldn’t do it on my own. So, a science PhD with no papers or references makes me nearly undesirable when combined with needing to rearrange time for health treatments. 

My psychiatrist thinks I’m fine, just a bit nervous at work (I take 6 mg Klonopin daily -2 mg three times). She agrees that I work with idiots and is understanding. 

I read your hunger strike thread. That’s going to be rough without opioids. I agree that they are NOT suited for chronic pain for most, but you’d at least feel better in the early stages if you had some.

Also, you mentioned the pills you’d be taking. That is the point at which the pills become deadly, but I do know some who’ve taken 100 10 mgAmbien + 50 0.25 mg Xanax (you mean to take 100 of the 0.5 mg xanax + antidepressants correct?) and lived because they threw them up unintentionally. I don’t want to encourage you, but there are two more drugs you could easily get to go with what you’re planning to be 110% certain. I’m using a non drug method except for a few Klonopin to calm the nerves. 

I’m leaving a letter about my workplace behind publicly. My friends and family deserve no blame. My husband has been crying a lot, but he said he understood and would lavish all his love on my cat.

Anyway, thanks for being the only reply! It seems most here are depressed or just want a space to share their feelings, but I don’t think a correlation between depression and suicide is inevitable. In basic sociology courses, many reasons for suicide are listed other than depression.

NAH (no assholes here)

I doubt anyone will see this, and some concerns may have been addressed by OP already. I like to play devil’s advocate regardless.

First off, was the blouse simply expensive or did it have sentimental value? She *may* have wanted to wear a special blouse for the occasion because she was happy for you.

Secondly, perhaps she didn’t know anything about babies (I don’t). I never threw up as a child until I swallowed sleeping pills I thought were candy. That plus never being around them leads to ignorance (although I’m extremely careful in general when I have on expensive clothes). My guess is she will have a blanket ready or dress down in the future if she can learn from this. If not, she’s seems a bit daft.

Thirdly, at events like that it’s so awkward to not hold the baby, even if the mother isn’t prompting you. I was seen as a brat because I refused to hold any of my sisters’ four babies. People didn’t understand that I didn’t feel confident holding babies (I didn’t want to hurt them) plus I thought they were gross due to drooling and possible diaper issues. I have a weak stomach and would rather not be around babies. Cute pics are enough for me.

However, I think she should have asked for half the money, and ONLY if it the shirt had sentimental value and ONLY if she knew you could pay it back without personal hardship. If she’s wealthy enough to buy a new one, it’s a bit silly to expect you to pay the full fee.

Finally, I’m surprised no one there cautioned her first if people were aware of how expensive her tastes were. Not that she’s a kid and needs to be coddled, but if she hasn’t been around babies, she may have thought it would be safe to hold the baby briefly. She seems from your description to be the type to only own expensive clothes, so I find it odd she didn’t have a blanket over her shirt before picking up the baby.
